intent.problem: A conversation agent needs a visible, auditable robot-simulation control surface that can complete one closed-loop goal without direct MuJoCo mutation, arbitrary browser automation, or cross-run command replay.
intent.target_users: Robotics demonstrators, AI-agent developers, simulation researchers, and evaluators.

product.agent_role: Co-worker for controlling a Microduck robot simulation.
product.benefit: Explore robot movement and ball play using everyday language in a visible simulation.
product.customizable_for: Robotics demonstrations, simulation research, AI tool testing, and ball-navigation experiments.
product.how_it_works: Opens the simulator in one browser control tab, turns your Chat requests into supported actions, and uses position feedback to guide ball approach and play.
product.input: The included demo, one local browser control tab, and your requests in Chat.
product.output: An interactive robot simulation, current movement status, command history, and a saved run summary.
product.problem: Robot demonstrations need controls that are easy to explain, observe, and stop.
product.simulation_type: Browser-based robot simulation with movement, ball approach, and continuous play controls.
product.target_users: Robotics demonstrators, AI-agent developers, simulation researchers, and evaluators.

overview: Control a simulated Microduck robot through Chat. Ask it to move, approach a ball, or keep finding and kicking the ball while you watch. You can stop play at any time.
